title: Building High-Quality Datasets for Portuguese LLMs: From Common Crawl Snapshots to Industrial-Grade Corpora
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and evaluation of a large-scale Portuguese dataset for LLMs. While it uses a classifier to filter toxic and offensive content (including hate speech and extremist rhetoric) as part of its data-cleaning pipeline, it does not involve benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or philosophical ethics as a core component of its study.
